design.baseline_prompt: first-frame target-mask centroid, reused from the prior SAM2 observer report
design.prompt_validity: Every perturbed positive point was checked to remain inside the known first-frame target mask. This is an oracle-prompt sensitivity test, not detector evaluation.

limits: The original center-prompt baseline was reused; only the plus/minus 4 px vertical variants were newly run.
The initial point is selected using known synthetic target masks; this does not measure detector-in-the-wild prompt quality.
Only two correlated simple Kubric sphere clips and two vertical offsets were assessed.
No Wan labels, DiTraj generation, control actuation, or feedback efficacy were tested.
